<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally:</strong> The Sensex surged 965 points and the Nifty closed above 24,300, driven by strong performance in IT and banking stocks alongside optimism surrounding Q1 earnings.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>SEBI policy update:</strong> SEBI has extended the facility for automated Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) and Systematic Transfer Plans (STP) to mutual fund units held in demat accounts, with a phased rollout expected by April 2027.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Economic outlook:</strong> RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that while the Indian economy remains resilient, West Asia geopolitical tensions and a weak monsoon remain the primary risks to growth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxOQnRFdnhodV9ETHEyckNkNHF5LVFmT0NQdFFrQkhGenByRlcxMkM1TDJ1MmNta25jT3lLSkpQaEpZTDcwSE1lN1FfQTM4S0FKd09RNkdvOTExMkxQYjBmeTM4cFQ4V1N2bEFkQ29GdTZCMkVPLTZSQnozX2Zjd0xPSWVVZm1ENktVZkNDUkYtejJwSExvMHd6VDUyLWdhRXd4d1Jka3V6QVpnWWFpT180eU1VejlvekxmMlczRC1FVQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
